entries:
The number of Trainers on the
Royal Unova today is {VAR 0200 0003}.{VAR BE01}
The ship is nearing the port.
Would you like to get off the ship?

The Royal Unova's renowned observation
deck is just ahead.

It seems the number of Trainers in the
cabins with blue doors today is {VAR 0200 0002}.

It's running on the ocean!
What a peculiar thing to see!

I'm running with the rhythm of the waves,
but it's a real challenge!
I'm still wondering which cabin to enter.

I came here from Johto for business,
but everything is dynamic here.

Oh! A whistle is blowing!
Sorry to keep you so long...{VAR BE01}
But it was fun to talk with you.
Thank you!

A battle break from work!
It is particularly fun.{VAR BE01}

I had a great battle on my break
from work.

I am having a relaxing time in this
opulent cabin.

I can have Pokémon battles while
I'm being rocked in the ship.{VAR BE01}
Plus, I can see Pokémon that are rarely
seen. I am soooo happy!

Did you go to the observation deck?
You can see an incredible view!

I lost...
Maybe I will go check out the view...

Argh! I lost!
I take off my socks to you!

My Pokémon! Weren't they unusual?
In particular, Wormadam is my favorite!

This gorgeous ship suits a rich person
like me très bien. Am I right?

I will show you a graceful battle
on this elegant ship!{VAR BE01}

With a few waltz steps, I will
choreograph a royal Pokémon battle!{VAR BE01}

I am enraptured with the royal
Pokémon battle...

You see two or three moves ahead.
Sure enough, I can't win against youth!

Hi there! You are such a cute guest.
May I have a Pokémon battle with you?{VAR BE01}

You're not only cute--you're also
strong in Pokémon battles!

Oh, I can feel the sound in my stomach!
The sound of that whistle is powerful!

Oops. Did I talk your ear off? Sorry,
sorry. But I had a great time. Thanks!

I can't believe you're stronger than me.
I have traveled around the world!{VAR BE01}
Now I understand...
the world is ridiculously big!

If you're so inclined, speak to me.
I will give you a hint anytime.

Do you want to know a hint
about looking for Trainers?
Certainly. Just a moment, please.{VAR BE01}

Certainly.
Please continue to have a great time!
Won against every Trainer on the ship!
